 FOR SUBSCRIBERS 2026 Election 7 charts that illustrate the scope of Democrats’ big 2026 wave
 Monster showings in the early vote, big swings in Trump country, records broken in key Senate races and more show the depth and breadth of the 2026 midterm results. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 People wait in line for early voting in Cary, N.C., on Oct. 25 in a state that ultimately flipped a Senate seat Democratic. Allison Joyce / AFP via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 7, 2026, 6:00 AM EST By Ben Kamisar The scope of Democrats’ resounding midterm victory is clear from the margins, with the party already securing 250 House seats and 54 Senates seats and still in the hunt in dozens of races that remain uncalled.
